entities.name: @okie/scene-compiler
entities.responsibility: Compiles architecture snapshots and stories into the v1 renderer scene protocol, C4 dynamic-flow artifacts, and the hand-authored golden demo fixture.

entities.name: scripts/generate-golden-source-excerpts.mjs
entities.responsibility: Regenerates checked golden source excerpts from pinned path+symbol+line anchors.

entities.name: src/compile-c4.ts
entities.responsibility: Compiles a C4 projection bundle into the renderer scene used by the atlas.

entities.name: src/compile-normalized.ts
entities.responsibility: Compiles a normalized architecture selection into scene objects.

entities.name: src/compile-scene.ts
entities.responsibility: Generic scene compiler from snapshot + view layouts into protocol objects and relations.

entities.name: src/compile-story.ts
entities.responsibility: Compiles an architecture story into a renderer timeline.

entities.name: src/display-text.ts
entities.responsibility: Fits labels to available width using path/word/identifier display modes.

entities.name: src/dynamic-flow.ts
entities.responsibility: Builds C4 dynamic-flow story artifacts from snapshot relations.

entities.name: src/generate-fixtures.ts
entities.responsibility: Writes the checked demo snapshot/scene/timeline fixtures from the golden semantic model.

entities.name: src/golden-fixture.ts
entities.responsibility: Hand-authored golden Okie self-map: the semantic source of truth for dogfooding pins.

entities.name: src/golden-source-excerpts.ts
entities.responsibility: Generated frozen source excerpts; regenerate rather than hand-edit.

entities.name: src/protocol.ts
entities.responsibility: TypeScript mirror of crates/atlas-protocol v1 camelCase renderer protocol.

entities.name: src/theme.ts
entities.responsibility: Scene fill/text colors keyed by entity kind for compiled atlas scenes.

entities.name: compileC4Scene
entities.responsibility: Compiles a C4 projection bundle into the atlas scene protocol the renderer consumes.
